top_signal.title: Co founder agreed to part ways but keeps stalling on the paperwork. What are my options??
top_signal.summary: My co founder and I co own a small mission driven LLC and have decided to part ways after a long fallout. The resentment built over several years. He stepped back from the project for a stretch last year after a family loss and some other hard personal setbacks, and I have empathy for what he's gone through. I ended up running almost everything myself most of last year and when he returned, the team had changed and the work had moved on. Looking back, I needed a true business partner and he struggled with firm deadlines and delivering anything on time. I also made mistakes: I let us grow too fast and took on too much myself which caused problems.   We met earlier this month, agreed on the broad terms, and agreed to wrap up within about a week. A lawyer drafted a settlement and wind down agreement, which I sent over. He said he’d send edits “this week,” then “still in review.” It’s now about two+ weeks past the date we agreed on, and I’ve followed up politely several times.   One complication: he is holding some shared materials that third parties are waiting on, and using it as leverage in the negotiation. A demand letter went out months ago, and my lawyer has also spoken with him. I’ve covered the legal fees so far, and each extra round of email to and from the lawyer adds billable hours. I don’t want to and can't escalate (its also not worth doing so), but I can’t keep paying for the delay, especially going into November.   Questions:     If he never signs, what are typical
